page.layout: One page of text in a decorative woodcut border; running head at top centre with page number at top right; signature and catchword at foot inside the border. No margin notes. The left edge shows part of the facing page (show-through and neighbouring edge), which is not transcribed.

main_text.p: neris & Martis commiscenda est, testificatur: Non posse Dominum (nempe aurum) de suo vestitu quidquam suis subditis impartiri: quandoquidem natura ei unicum duntaxat indumentum honorarium tribuit, nisi prius servus ditârit Dominum: Item paulò post addit: Non posse Regem suis famulis de regno suo quidquam hæreditatis communicare, nec perseverantem vestitum aulicum tribuere, nisi prius pensionem & tributum à suis subditis acceperit, ut ita Dominus & servus simul consistere possint. Hæc cùm ita sint, non immeritò quis interrogârit, Quo pacto igitur tinctura Solis secundum essentialem sui differentiam à tinctura Veneris & Martis aut reliquarum diftet? page.notes: The running head and page number are printed as "HELIANA." and "21". The line "Quo pacto" and similar words are set in italic in the scan; the catchword "sub-" is hyphenated at the line end and continues on the next page. The leftmost strip of the scan shows fragments of the adjacent page and is not transcribed. Text is printed in a roman and italic mix; the long s is rendered as s throughout.
